title: Independent zero-network audit of full 1,433-wallet GMGN stats rerun
objective: Independently audit the completed full 1,433-wallet rerun without issuing network requests. Verify Git/evidence chain, input hashes, exact deterministic selection, batching and request budget, serial-delay contract, normalized output schema, aggregate status/coverage/warnings, privacy boundaries, and whether the rerun may be marked complete.
forbidden_actions: Do not issue network, provider, or GMGN CLI requests.
Do not read credentials, plaintext addresses, labels, raw provider payloads, raw stdout/stderr, proxy URLs, or complete exceptions.
Do not modify application, parser, runner, tests, or external live output.
Do not mark the full rerun complete if hashes, selected count, request cap, serial execution, sanitized schema, or source/verification semantics fail.
